authority_rule: Chat captures preserve intent and decisions; repository evidence establishes implementation state.

evidence_classes.BINDING_DECISION: Explicitly approved direction or repeated mandatory rule.
evidence_classes.HISTORICAL_CLAIM: Reported installation, test count or completion requiring repository verification.
evidence_classes.PROPOSAL: Suggested capability not automatically approved or implemented.
evidence_classes.REPOSITORY_EVIDENCE: Current code, tests, specification, installer or release evidence.

recovered_decisions.decision: The real repository is authoritative; additions are installed through declared, backed-up, tested and rollback-capable packages.
A typed event and dependency graph shall synchronize BIM, rendering, quantities, structures, energy and external adapters without tight coupling.
AIAS shall be a professional integrated AEC experience, not hundreds of disconnected classes or engines.
BIM, structural analysis, geotechnics, civil infrastructure and professional connectors belong to one BIM/CAE platform.
Advanced geotechnics, deep foundations, diaphragm walls, soil-structure interaction, hydraulics, sanitation, stormwater, GIS, roads and earthworks are mandatory long-term disciplines.
Engineering data and knowledge shall be centralized, normalized, versioned and shared by FEM, design, documentation and AI.
Every new module shall integrate immediately into the application and deliver code, interface, tests, documentation and a working reference-project case.
The product objective is a complete workflow: model, analyze, design, optimize and document without leaving AIAS; the AI Engineering Brain reasons over the complete technical context.
AIAS shall version its own living knowledge: architecture, ADRs, installed modules, implemented standards and sprint state beside code.
Package, registry, update, test and factory infrastructure shall be integrated and observable from the product, not remain terminal-only utilities.
Infrastructure growth gives way to complete engineering verticals with real consumers; module-count inflation is prohibited.
Constitution and SDD are executable authorities; specification precedes code and generates architecture, implementation, tests, documentation, installer, traceability and release evidence.

historical_claim_policy.treatment: Do not promote to current completion without reproducible repository verification.
